world_available_opportunity.description: An existing MELON seed could be moved/planted into productive State before Day5, yielding a public-rule Day10 production opportunity.

current_hour.note: Available in observation; current Strong Origin does not use hour.

self_input_access.conclusion: No dynamic observation/input gap was found for the certified Day4 h10 existing-seed entry.

currently_used_semantics: remaining_days is compared with FIRST_YIELD to suppress very-late crop scoring
MAX_YIELD_DAY is used in harvest timing checks
missing_explicit_mapping: No explicit current-body representation maps a contemplated Day4 MELON entry to its next production opportunity Day10.
The public non-ongoing crop WATER production window formula is not represented as a reachable-future horizon in Strong Origin's decision state.

derived_observations: The certified opportunity was not hidden by missing dynamic input: day, money, seed stock, tiles, empty space, and unit positions were all available to the self input.
Most of those dynamic facts are already directly read by the current Body.
Therefore World-available -> Self-input-accessible is not the observed gap at Day4 h10.
The current Body has some crop maturity constants but no explicit reachable-future representation that projects a contemplated entry onto the next production window.
The next layer to test is Self-accessible facts -> Internal Representation, not resource feasibility or observation acquisition.
boundary: This audit does not claim the opportunity was internally understood, valued, selected, or executable under the policy.
Current-hour availability is distinguished from current-hour use.
Public-rule availability at environment/codebase level is not treated as equivalent to internal representation.
No Candidate, Direction, or policy mutation is introduced.
